title: lactuca biennis
intro: Lactuca biennis, commonly known as tall bitter lettuce, is a biennial plant species in the dandelion family that is native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially aiding in the relief of digestive issues and pain management. The therapeutic actions of Lactuca biennis are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Lactuca biennis include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
